questions: Which of the 17 cross-repo issue-shape findings are genuine?
Does the shared detector back a fail-closed gate?
Does any test pin the current behaviour?

findings.statement: 5 of 17 cross-repo issue-shape findings name this repository itself; the detector matches the Repo-hash-number shape without excluding the scanned repository
findings.evidence: github_surface scan: five self-named findings across pr bodies 387, 386, 372, 371 and 370

findings.statement: The sibling URL detector already excludes self via _SELF_REPO at publication_boundary_lint.py:92; the issue-shape loop at :94-95 appends unconditionally
A bare hash-number reference already passes as a self-reference while the same reference in qualified form is flagged: one reference, two forms, opposite verdicts
findings.evidence: executed scan_text matrix over five shapes

findings.statement: scan_text backs two surfaces: the tracked-file lint that runs fail-closed in CI gate-chain-completeness, and the read-only GitHub scan. The tracked-file lint reported 0 findings before this phase authored any document
findings.evidence: publication_boundary_lint: 0 finding(s) on a clean tree

findings.statement: No test pins that a self-reference is flagged; the existing test uses a foreign-repo fixture and asserts a bare hash-number reference passes
The operator terms overlay holds 17 terms and none is the sibling repository name, so naming it in prose is not a violation under configured policy; an earlier assumption to the contrary was wrong
findings.evidence: membership check against the gitignored overlay without printing it

findings.statement: The issue-shape regex requires an uppercase initial, so an all-lowercase repository name in the same shape is never matched. Pre-existing and not introduced here; stated because it bounds what a clean scan means
findings.evidence: executed: lowercase form clean, capitalized form flagged

findings.statement: A plan document quoting these findings trips the fail-closed lint 23 times. The doctrine grants a per-line exception marker and the detector own test file already uses it; the plan carries the same marker
findings.evidence: publication_boundary_lint run against the authored plan
